events.name: Android 17 QPR2 stable rollout for Pixel
events.summary: Android 17 QPR2 stable began rolling out to Pixel 6a through Pixel 11 Pro Fold on 2026-11-10, a month before the expected December Pixel Drop, according to 9to5Google. The stable OTA size is not stated by any source I read. Lead only: a Beta 4 OTA was reported at about 3.94 GB on Pixel 11 Pro.

events.name: Metaphor: ReFantazio – Nintendo Switch 2
events.summary: Switch 2 version of Atlus' RPG, 12 Nov 2026. Nintendo eShop lists an estimated 62.1 GB (may change before launch).

title.name: Pikmin 4: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy

events.name: Pikmin 4: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy
events.summary: Switch 2 edition upgrade/release 12 Nov 2026; size not found.

events.name: Sonic Pico Park
events.summary: Multiplatform release 12 Nov 2026; likely small download.

events.name: Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea (expansion)
events.summary: Paid expansion. The only source I could read is an unlisted outlet (nintendoeverything.com). It names Switch and Switch 2. The Nintendo Direct recap I opened (playday.one) lists the game for November 2026 on Switch 2, Switch, Xbox and PlayStation, so other platforms are likely but I did not confirm them. No download size found. No publisher or store page was opened, so the date is not confirmed by tier A. No artwork found.

events.name: Grand Theft Auto VI
events.summary: Rockstar's GTA VI launches Nov 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Digital pre-load opened Nov 10 (PS5 at midnight local time; Xbox at 12 a.m. GMT). Rockstar says pre-load needs up to 212 GB depending on device; the figure is an upper limit, not a per-console size. Start time is shown at day level (00:00Z); PS5 opens by local midnight, so UTC varies by region.

events.name: iOS 27.3, iPadOS 27.3 and macOS Golden Gate 27.3
events.summary: Developer beta 1 of iOS 27.3 and macOS Golden Gate 27.3 shipped 3 Nov 2026 and public betas followed 5 Nov. Apple has said the release comes in December 2026 but has given no day, so the date is month precision. Download size is not stated by any tier A or B source found.

events.name: Thief: The Dark Project Remastered
events.summary: Nightdive remaster launching on Steam, Epic, GOG and consoles. Steam lists 5 GB storage. No preload noted on the store page; no unlock hour published.

title.name: DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World

events.name: DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World
events.summary: Square Enix release on PS5, Xbox, Switch, Switch 2 and PC; a Digital Deluxe early access from Dec 1 was reported by press (not read on a primary page). Download size and preload window not found.

events.name: Xenoblade Chronicles 3 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
events.summary: Switch 2 Edition of Xenoblade Chronicles 3, physical and digital, with an upgrade pack for existing owners. Date shown on Nintendo regional store pages (UK 03/12/2026) per search results; I did not open the pages myself. Size not found. One outlier gave Dec 9.

events.name: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV
events.summary: RTS from KING Art Games and Deep Silver, delayed from Sept 17 to Dec 3, 2026. Commander Edition buyers get advance access from Nov 30. Steam lists no storage figure and no preload yet; system requirements are still 'Coming soon'.

events.name: Monster Hunter Wilds – Nintendo Switch 2
events.summary: Switch 2 release 4 Dec 2026. Nintendo listing reportedly shows ~39.1 GB estimate (read via search summary, store page not quoted directly; size may change).

events.name: Guns of Eschaton
events.summary: First-person soulslike by 4Divinity and Eschatology Entertainment, with Viktor Antonov's art direction. Steam lists Planned Release Date Dec 8, 2026, and a demo has been on Steam since Oct 2026. Size and preload are unknown; it is probably small and may fall below the 2 GB threshold. Included as a low-popularity lead only.

events.name: Windows 11 2026-12 B cumulative update (Patch Tuesday)
events.summary: Monthly security cumulative update for Windows 11 26H2, 25H2, 24H2 and 26H1, expected on the second Tuesday of December (2026-12-08). The date follows Microsoft's usual pattern, since the release-health page shows the 2026-11 B update on 2026-11-10 and the 2026-10 B update on 2026-10-13. Size not stated; typically under 1 GB and the platform bound is 12 GB. Windows 11 26H2 reached general availability on 2026-09-29.

title.name: Professor Layton and the New World of Steam

events.name: Professor Layton and the New World of Steam
events.summary: Release 9 Dec 2026 (10 Dec in Japan) per Steam and PS Store. Size is estimated at 3.2 GB from the previous franchise release, Layton's Mystery Journey Deluxe on Switch (Nintendo AU page); no stated size yet. No preload found.

events.name: Attack on Titan 3
events.summary: Release 10 Dec 2026 (Steam 9 Dec). Size not stated by any source yet; 30 GB is estimated from the franchise's previous release, Attack on Titan 2: Final Battle, whose Steam page states 30 GB. A tier C tracker lists 104 GB.

events.name: Kirby and the World Beyond
events.summary: Switch 2 exclusive, stated by Nintendo only as spring 2027, so the date is the season starting 1 March 2027 (no day known). About 21.9 GB estimated from Kirby Air Riders' 21.9 GB file size on the Nintendo store. No preload known.

events.name: Frostpunk 1886
events.summary: Steam lists only 2027; no day or month is stated. Size is not yet listed (requirements TBA); about 30 GB estimated from Frostpunk 2's 30 GB storage requirement on Steam.

events.name: Kingdom Hearts IV
events.summary: Release stated only as 2027 on the Steam page. Press says late 2027, but I could not open a press page. The size is an estimate of about 75 GB, taken from the Steam storage requirement of the franchise's previous main game, Kingdom Hearts III + Re Mind. Platform list comes from press, not a page I opened.

events.name: Danganronpa 2x2
events.summary: Spike Chunsoft's expanded Danganronpa sequel. Steam lists 13 Jan 2027; press reports 14 January 2027 for Europe and Japan (store time zones differ). The 30 GB size is the Steam PC requirement; it is 40 GB with the deluxe contents app. Console sizes and preload windows are not yet published.

events.name: Metroid Ravenous
events.summary: Switch 2 exclusive 2D Metroid, release January 28, 2027. The eShop page gives an estimated file size of 20.2 GB. No preload window is announced yet.

events.name: METRO 2039
events.summary: Release 4 Feb 2027 on Steam, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. No size is stated yet; about 59 GB estimated from Metro Exodus's 59 GB storage requirement on Steam. No preload announced yet.

events.name: Persona 4 Revival
events.summary: Reported for February 18, 2027 on PS5, Xbox Series and PC (Steam shows Feb 17 in some time zones); Switch 2 version May 20, 2027. I could not read the date or storage on a page I opened: the Steam page was age-gated. No size or preload known.

events.name: Fable
events.summary: Xbox/Playground Games' Fable launches February 23, 2027 on PS5, Xbox Series and PC (Steam, Xbox on PC), with Premium Edition early access from February 18. The Steam page was behind an age gate so no storage requirement or preload could be read; one unverified guide says 135 GB. No preload announced.

events.name: iOS 27.4 and iPadOS 27.4 (spring release)
events.summary: MacRumors reports Apple is already testing iOS 27.4 and calls it the 'spring' software release. No day is stated, so starts_at is the first day of March 2027 as an approximation of spring (quarter precision). No size is stated yet; no comparable size was sourced.

events.name: EXODUS
events.summary: Archetype Entertainment's EXODUS launches April 7, 2027 on PC (Steam, Epic), PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. The date is stated on the Steam store page and in the publisher's news post. Size is an estimate of 125 GB taken from Starfield's Steam storage line, since EXODUS's Steam page says 'TBD'. No preload is announced.

events.name: FINAL FANTASY VII REVELATION
events.summary: Releases April 8, 2027 on Steam, Epic, Xbox on PC, PS5, Xbox Series and Switch 2. Premium editions get 24-hour early access from April 7, 2027 14:00 UTC. Steam lists no storage requirement yet (OS TBD). The estimated 155 GB comes from FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH's 155 GB storage requirement on Steam. No preload window announced.

events.name: Emirates FA Cup Final 2027, Wembley
events.summary: FA Cup final on Saturday 22 May 2027 at Wembley. Kick-off time not yet announced. Service is a best estimate: TNT Sports holds the rights and sub-licenses 14 games a season to the BBC; I could not confirm on a tier A page that the BBC simulcasts the final.

events.name: Premier League final round, all ten matches simultaneous
events.summary: Final round of the 2026/27 Premier League on Sunday 30 May 2027, all ten games at the same time. Kick-off time not stated on the page I read; whether any title or relegation decider is live is known only later. Sky Sports shows the final day (service inferred from Sky's own page).
